description: This file defines a REST controller named HealthController that provides simple health check endpoints (/health and /healthz) for a Spring Boot application. It uses annotations for API documentation and specifies JSON responses indicating the application's health status.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: REST controller providing health check endpoints for application monitoring.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with status 'UP' indicating the application is healthy.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with status 'ok' for compatibility health checks.
